The '''Buried Field''' was the name given to the snowfield on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] that lay north of the [[Jagged Plains]] in the [[Clabburn Tundra]] and south of [[Crescent Canyon]]. The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Jagged Plains Imperial Garrison]] was located on the eastern end of the field, and the [[Lamplit Path]] led from the garrison to the eastern end of Crescent Canyon.
